Meanwhile, Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the disciples of the Lord. He approached the high priest
But Saul, still burning with desire to put to death the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest,
掃羅仍然向主的門徒口吐威嚇凶煞的話，去見大祭司，
and requested letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any men or women belonging to the Way, he could bring them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
And made a request for letters from him to the Synagogues of Damascus, so that if there were any of the Way there, men or women, he might take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
求文書給大馬士革的各會堂，若是找著信奉這道的人，無論男女，都准他捆綁帶到耶路撒冷。
As Saul drew near to Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
And while he was journeying, he came near Damascus; and suddenly he saw a light from heaven shining round him;
掃羅行路，將到大馬士革，忽然從天上發光，四面照著他；
He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?”
And he went down on the earth, and a voice said to him, Saul, Saul, why are you attacking me so cruelly?
他就仆倒在地，聽見有聲音對他說：「掃羅！掃羅！你為甚麼逼迫我？」
“Who are You, Lord?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” He replied.
And he said, Who are you, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus, whom you are attacking:
他說：「主啊！你是誰？」主說：「我就是你所逼迫的耶穌。
“Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”
But get up, and go into the town, and it will be made clear to you what you have to do.
起來！進城去，你所當做的事，必有人告訴你。」
The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless. They heard the voice but did not see anyone.
And the men who were with him were not able to say anything; hearing the voice, but seeing no one.
同行的人站在那裡，說不出話來，聽見聲音，卻看不見人。
Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could not see a thing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.
And Saul got up from the earth, and when his eyes were open, he saw nothing; and he was guided by the hand into Damascus.
掃羅從地上起來，睜開眼睛，竟不能看見甚麼。有人拉他的手，領他進了大馬士革；
For three days he was without sight, and he did not eat or drink anything.
And for three days he was not able to see, and he took no food or drink.
三日不能看見，也不吃也不喝。
In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord spoke to him in a vision, “Ananias!” “Here I am, Lord,” he answered.
Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and the Lord said to him in a vision, Ananias! and he said, Here I am, Lord.
當下，在大馬士革有一個門徒，名叫亞拿尼亞。主在異象中對他說：「亞拿尼亞。」他說：「主，我在這裡。」
“Get up!” the Lord told him. “Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.
And the Lord said to him, Get up, and go to the street which is named Straight, and make search at the house of Judas for one named Saul of Tarsus: for he is at prayer;
主對他說：「起來！往直街去，在猶大的家裡，訪問一個大數人，名叫掃羅。他正禱告，
In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.”
And he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and putting his hands on him, so that he may be able to see.
又看見了一個人，名叫亞拿尼亞，進來按手在他身上，叫他能看見。」
But Ananias answered, “Lord, many people have told me about this man and all the harm he has done to Your saints in Jerusalem.
But Ananias said, Lord, I have had accounts of this man from a number of people, how much evil he has done to your saints at Jerusalem:
亞拿尼亞回答說：「主啊，我聽見許多人說：這人怎樣在耶路撒冷多多苦害你的聖徒，
And now he is here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on Your name.”
And here he has authority from the chief priests to make prisoners all who give worship to your name.
並且他在這裡有從祭司長得來的權柄捆綁一切求告你名的人。」
“Go!” said the Lord. “This man is My chosen instrument to carry My name before the Gentiles and their kings, and before the people of Israel.
But the Lord said, Go without fear: for he is a special vessel for me, to give to the Gentiles and kings and to the children of Israel the knowledge of my name:
主對亞拿尼亞說：「你只管去！他是我所揀選的器皿，要在外邦人和君王，並以色列人面前宣揚我的名。
I will show him how much he must suffer for My name.”
For I will make clear to him what troubles he will have to undergo for me.
我也要指示他，為我的名必須受許多的苦難。」

So Ananias went to the house, and when he arrived, he placed his hands on Saul. “Brother Saul,” he said, “the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here, has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

And Ananias went out and came to the house, and putting his hands on him, said, Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, whom you saw when you were on your journey, has sent me, so that you may be able to see, and be full of the Holy Spirit.
亞拿尼亞就去了，進入那家，把手按在掃羅身上，說：「兄弟掃羅，在你來的路上向你顯現的主，就是耶穌，打發我來，叫你能看見，又被聖靈充滿。」
At that instant, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and his sight was restored. He got up and was baptized,
And straight away it seemed as if a veil was taken from his eyes, and he was able to see; and he got up, and had baptism;
掃羅的眼睛上，好像有鱗立刻掉下來，他就能看見。於是起來受了洗；
and after taking some food, he regained his strength. And he spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.
And when he had taken food his strength came back. And for some days he kept with the disciples who were in Damascus.
吃過飯就健壯了。掃羅和大馬士革的門徒同住了些日子，
Saul promptly began to proclaim Jesus in the synagogues, declaring, “He is the Son of God.”
And straight away, in the Synagogues, he was preaching Jesus as the Son of God.
就在各會堂裡宣傳耶穌，說他是神的兒子。
All who heard him were astounded and asked, “Isn’t this the man who wreaked havoc in Jerusalem on those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?”

And all those hearing him were full of wonder and said, Is not this the man who in Jerusalem was attacking all the worshippers of this name? and he had come here so that he might take them as prisoners before the chief priests.
凡聽見的人都驚奇，說：「在耶路撒冷殘害求告這名的，不是這人嗎？並且他到這裡來，特要捆綁他們，帶到祭司長那裡。」
But Saul was empowered all the more, and he confounded the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.
But Saul went on increasing in power, and the Jews in Damascus were not able to give answers to the arguments by which he made it clear that Jesus was the Christ.
但掃羅越發有能力，駁倒住大馬士革的猶太人，證明耶穌是基督。
After many days had passed, the Jews conspired to kill him,
Then, after some days, the Jews made an agreement together to put him to death:
過了好些日子，猶太人商議要殺掃羅，
but Saul learned of their plot. Day and night they watched the city gates in order to kill him.
But Saul got knowledge of their design. And they kept watch day and night on the roads out of the town, so that they might put him to death:
但他們的計謀被掃羅知道了。他們又晝夜在城門守候，要殺他。
One night, however, his disciples took him and lowered him in a basket through a window in the wall.
But his disciples took him by night and let him down from the wall in a basket.
他的門徒就在夜間用筐子把他從城牆上縋下去。
When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
And when he came to Jerusalem, he made an attempt to be joined to the disciples, but they were all in fear of him, not taking him for a disciple.
掃羅到了耶路撒冷，想與門徒結交，他們卻都怕他，不信他是門徒。
Then Barnabas brought him to the apostles and described how Saul had seen the Lord, who spoke to him on the road to Damascus, and how Saul had spoken boldly in that city in the name of Jesus.

But Barnabas took him to the Apostles and gave them an account of how he had seen the Lord on the road, and had given hearing to his words, and how at Damascus he had been preaching in the name of Jesus without fear.
惟有巴拿巴接待他，領去見使徒，把他在路上怎麼看見主，主怎麼向他說話，他在大馬士革怎麼奉耶穌的名放膽傳道，都述說出來。
So Saul stayed with them, moving about freely in Jerusalem and speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
And he was with them, going in and out at Jerusalem,
於是掃羅在耶路撒冷和門徒出入來往，
He talked and debated with the Grecian Jews, but they tried to kill him.
Preaching in the name of the Lord without fear; and he had discussions with the Greek Jews; but they were working for his death.
奉主的名放膽傳道，並與說希臘話的猶太人講論辯駁；他們卻想法子要殺他。
When the brothers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
And when the brothers had knowledge of it, they took him to Caesarea and sent him to Tarsus.
弟兄們知道了就送他下凱撒利亞，打發他往大數去。
Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria experienced a time of peace. It grew in strength and numbers, living in the fear of the Lord and the encouragement of the Holy Spirit.
And so the church through all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria had peace and was made strong; and, living in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, was increased greatly.
那時，猶太、加利利、撒馬利亞各處的教會都得平安，被建立；凡事敬畏主，蒙聖靈的安慰，人數就增多了。
As Peter traveled throughout the area, he went to visit the saints in Lydda.
And it came about that while Peter was going through all parts of the country he came to the saints who were living at Lydda.
彼得周流四方的時候，也到了居住呂大的聖徒那裡；
There he found a man named Aeneas, who had been paralyzed and bedridden for eight years.
And there was a certain man there, named Aeneas, who for eight years had been in bed, without power of moving.
遇見一個人，名叫以尼雅，得了癱瘓，在褥子上躺臥八年。
“Aeneas,” Peter said to him, “Jesus Christ heals you! Get up and put away your mat.” Immediately Aeneas got up,
And Peter said to him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ makes you well: get up and make your bed. And straight away he got up.
彼得對他說：「以尼雅，耶穌基督醫好你了，起來！收拾你的褥子。」他就立刻起來了。
and all who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
And all those living in Lydda and Sharon saw him, and were turned to the Lord.
凡住呂大和沙崙的人都看見了他，就歸服主。
In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (which is translated as Dorcas), who was always occupied with works of kindness and charity.
Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, that is, Dorcas: this woman was given to good works and acts of mercy at all times.
在約帕有一個女徒，名叫大比大，翻希臘話就是多加（就是羚羊的意思）；她廣行善事，多施賙濟。
At that time, however, she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upper room.
And it came about, in those days, that she got ill and came to her death: and when she had been washed, they put her in a room which was high up.
當時，她患病而死，有人把她洗了，停在樓上。
Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples heard that Peter was there and sent two men to urge him, “Come to us without delay.”
And because Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, having knowledge that Peter was there, sent two men to him, requesting him to come to them straight away.
呂大原與約帕相近；門徒聽見彼得在那裡，就打發兩個人去見他，央求他說：「快到我們那裡去，不要耽延。」

So Peter got up and went with them. On his arrival, they took him to the upper room. All the widows stood around him, weeping and showing him the tunics and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.

And Peter went with them. And when he had come, they took him into the room: and all the widows were there, weeping and putting before him the coats and clothing which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
彼得就起身和他們同去；到了，便有人領他上樓。眾寡婦都站在彼得旁邊哭，拿多加與她們同在時所做的裡衣外衣給他看。
Then Peter sent them all out of the room. He knelt down and prayed, and turning toward her body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter, she sat up.
But Peter made them all go outside, and went down on his knees in prayer; and turning to the body, he said, Tabitha, get up. And, opening her eyes, she saw Peter and got up.
彼得叫她們都出去，就跪下禱告，轉身對著死人說：「大比大，起來！」她就睜開眼睛，見了彼得，便坐起來。
Peter took her by the hand and helped her up. Then he called the saints and widows and presented her to them alive.
And he took her hand, lifting her up; and, sending for the saints and widows, he gave her to them, living.
彼得伸手扶她起來，叫眾聖徒和寡婦進去，把多加活活地交給他們。
This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.
And news of it went all through Joppa, and a number of people had faith in the Lord.
這事傳遍了約帕，就有許多人信了主。
And Peter stayed for several days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
And he was living in Joppa for some time with Simon, a leather-worker.
此後，彼得在約帕一個硝皮匠西門的家裡住了多日。
